name: What types of non-slip bathroom flooring are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of non-slip bathroom flooring are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several options for non-slip bathroom flooring, each with distinct benefits. Textured ceramic or porcelain tiles, often with a matte finish, naturally offer more grip than smooth, glossy alternatives. Vinyl, particularly luxury vinyl plank (LVP) or tile (LVT), provides a water-resistant and comfortable surface that can mimic wood or stone, often featuring textured surfaces. Rubber flooring is highly slip-resistant and comfortable underfoot, suitable for high-traffic or accessibility-focused bathrooms. Additionally, some natural stone tiles can be treated or honed to increase their slip resistance, though their natural porosity requires proper sealing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include textured ceramic or porcelain tile, luxury vinyl plank/tile, and rubber flooring, each offering varying levels of slip resistance and aesthetics.
